summary: The Petitioner, NTPC Limited, has filed this Petition for the determination of tariff towards the installation of various Emission Control Systems (ECS) at the Feroze Gandhi Unchahar Thermal Power Station, Stage-IV (500 MW) (in short, “the generating station”) in compliance with the Revised Emission Standards and has sought the following relief(s): - _(i) Allow Petitioner to bill provisional supplementary tariff based on implementation of ECS system in the instant station till the Supplementary tariff is finally determined and approved by the Hon’ble Commission._ - _(vi) Pass any other order as it may deem fit in the circumstances mentioned above._ _“99. Besides the hard cost towards installation of WFGD, DSI based FGD system and DeNOx systems, the Petitioner has also claimed IDC, IEDC, FERV, taxes and duties and other costs. As the instant petitions are for “in-principle” approval of ACE towards installation of ECS to comply with the MoEFCC Notification, the Petitioner’s claim for the same is not considered in this order and these claims would be considered on case to case basis on the petitions to be filed by the Petitioner for determination of tariff after implementation of ECS as provided under Regulation 29(4) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations.”_ 6. In the above background, the Petitioner filed the present Petition under the provisions of the 2019 Tariff Regulations read with the First Amendment to the said Regulations. In response, the Petitioner has filed the additional information vide affidavit dated 29.5.2024, after serving a copy to the Respondents. Except for UPPCL (who had filed its reply affidavit dated 4.1.2024), none of the other Respondents have filed their reply/objections to the tariff proposal of the Petitioner. 8. Pursuant to the hearing on 11.7.2024, the Commission directed the Petitioner to file certain additional information, and in response, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 3.9.2024, has filed the information, after serving a copy on the Respondents. 9. Pursuant to the hearing on 30.9.2024, the Commission, after directing the Petitioner to file certain additional information and the parties to complete their pleadings, reserved its order in the Petition. In response, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 29.10.2024 has filed the additional information. None of the Respondents have filed their reply in the matter. 10.
